capabilities: Track net output and total input characters per file
Measure active editing time and rolling typing speed
Show a GitHub-style calendar heatmap and 7/30-day trend charts
Set daily and weekly word/time goals with progress rings
Export stats as JSON, CSV, or Markdown and back up data to a .typelog file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a Chinese-language introduction is linked at the top of the README.
problem: Obsidian's word count only shows the current document's word total, with no history of typing activity, active time, speed, or progress toward writing goals.
summary: Typing statistics plugin that tracks net vs. total input, active editing time, speed, a calendar heatmap, and daily writing goals.
